selected_evidence.requirement: Configure `/srv/drop` as shared writable with cross-owner deletion protection
selected_evidence.summary: The directory is `root:root` with mode `1777` (`drwxrwxrwt`). Both test users created files, while cross-owner removal failed. Final directory state is clean and ready.
Captured boot ID `3aee314b-4dfc-4c3a-90f6-2b07c621eaa0`, running system state, active local filesystems, mode `1777`, marker checksum, and deletion denial.
Native systemd reboot was scheduled and acknowledged before disconnection.
Observed new boot ID `339ec0f0-857d-4208-a9fc-454b5af0cd86`, proving node1 restarted.

System returned to running, local filesystems were active, directory remained mode `1777`, marker checksum matched, cross-owner deletion remained denied, and an unprivileged user could create a new file.
